name: Neman Aikin Gwamnati a Amurka (USAJOBS)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku sanarwar aikin gwamnatin tarayya kuma kun san tarihinku, gane hanyoyin ɗaukar aikin da kuke iya cancanta da su, da duba ko aiki yana buɗe gare ku, ta hanyar karanta sashen "This job is open to" daidai

Ta amfani da waya ko kwamfutar ɗakin karatu, buɗe asusu (profile) a USAJOBS da ajiye binciken aiki da aka tace da wuri, matakin albashi da hanyar ɗaukar aiki, ta amfani da shafin hukuma na usajobs.gov kaɗai, ba tare da biyan kowa ba

Idan aka ba ku sanarwar aiki ta gaske, jera ayyukan da za a yi, cancanta, matakin albashi, ranar rufewa da takardun da ake buƙata, a takardar taƙaitawa ta shafi ɗaya, ba tare da rashin ko ɗaya daga cikin biyar ɗin ba

Idan aka ba ku ƙwarewa ta musamman da sanarwa ke nema, rubuta ayyuka a takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya, da ranaku, awanni a mako, ayyuka da sakamako da suka dace da sanarwar, ta amfani da muhimman kalmomin sanarwar da bayanai na gaskiya kaɗai

Kafin ku aika neman aiki, amsa tambayoyin tantancewa da gaskiya da tara dukkan takardun da sanarwar ke buƙata, ta yadda takardar bayanin aikinku ke tabbatar da kowace babbar amsa, kuma babu takardar da ake buƙata da ta ɓace
Bayan kun nemi aiki, bin diddigin matsayin neman aikinku da gane tayin aikin gwamnati na bogi, kuna ajiye rajista mai ranaku, kuma ba ku taɓa biyan kuɗi ko bayar da lambobin sirri a wajen USAJOBS ba

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Nemo aikin gwamnatin tarayya da ke buɗe gare ku

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Yadda ɗaukar aikin gwamnatin tarayya ke aiki, da hanyoyin ɗaukar aikinku
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Gane hanyoyin ɗaukar aikin da kuke iya cancanta da su, da duba su wane ne aiki ke buɗe gare su.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku sanarwar aikin gwamnatin tarayya kuma kun san tarihinku, za ku iya gane hanyoyin ɗaukar aikin da kuke iya cancanta da su, da duba ko aiki yana buɗe gare ku, ta hanyar karanta sashen "This job is open to" daidai.
Ana saka ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya a USAJOBS, shafin hukuma da Office of Personnel Management (OPM) ke gudanarwa. Kowane aikin da aka saka ana kiransa sanarwar aiki (job announcement). Kowace hukuma (misali Department of Veterans Affairs, ma'aikatar tsoffin sojoji; Forest Service, hukumar gandun daji; ko IRS, hukumar haraji) ita ce ke karanta takardun neman aiki kuma ta yanke wanda ya cancanta.
Kowace sanarwa tana faɗin su wane ne za su iya nema, a wani sashe mai suna "This job is open to" (Wannan aikin yana buɗe ga). USAJOBS tana raba masu neman aiki zuwa hanyoyin ɗaukar aiki (hiring paths). Wasu daga cikinsu: Open to the public (buɗe ga jama'a: 'yan ƙasar Amurka da 'yan asalinta), Veterans (tsoffin sojoji), Military spouses (matan ko mazan sojoji), Individuals with disabilities (masu nakasa), Students (ɗalibai), Recent graduates (waɗanda suka gama karatu kwanan nan), Federal employees (ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya), da National Guard and reserves (sojojin ko-ta-kwana).
Idan aiki yana buɗe ga ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya kaɗai kuma ku ba ɗaya daga cikinsu ba ne, ba za a duba takardunku ba, komai kyawunsu. Don haka koyaushe ku fara duba wannan sashe. Wasu hanyoyi na musamman suna da nasu ƙa'idoji: misali masu nakasa za su iya nema ƙarƙashin Schedule A da wasiƙar shaidar nakasa, kuma tsoffin sojoji suna iya samun fifikon tsoffin sojoji (veterans' preference).
Albashin yawancin ayyukan ofis da na ƙwararru yana bin General Schedule (GS): matakai 15, daga GS-1 zuwa GS-15, kowanne da matakai (steps) 10, tare da ƙarin albashin yanki (locality pay) da ya danganta da inda kuke aiki. Yawancin ayyukan sana'o'in hannu da na ƙarfi suna amfani da wani tsari daban, Federal Wage System (sau da yawa ana nuna shi da WG).
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta hanyoyin ɗaukar aikin da za su iya dacewa da ku: jama'a, tsohon soja, matar ko mijin soja, nakasa, ɗalibi, wanda ya gama karatu kwanan nan ko wata.
- Ku buɗe wata sanarwa ku nemo "This job is open to".
- Ku duba cewa aƙalla hanya ɗaya da aka jera ta dace da ku.
- Idan babu wadda ta dace, ku bar wannan aikin ku nemi wani.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- USAJOBS: shafin intanet na hukuma, kyauta, inda ake saka ayyukan gwamnatin tarayyar Amurka.
- OPM: Office of Personnel Management, hukumar da ke kula da ƙa'idojin ɗaukar ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya da USAJOBS.
- Sanarwar aiki (job announcement): cikakken bayanin aikin: su wane ne za su iya nema, ayyukan da za a yi, cancanta, albashi da yadda ake nema.
- Hanyar ɗaukar aiki (hiring path): rukunin mutanen da aiki ke buɗe gare su, kamar jama'a, tsoffin sojoji ko ɗalibai.
- Schedule A: wani iko na ɗaukar aiki da ke bar hukumomi su ɗauki masu nakasa ba tare da gasar da aka saba ba.
- General Schedule (GS): babban tsarin albashin gwamnatin tarayya, mai matakai GS-1 zuwa GS-15 da steps 10 a kowane mataki.
- Ƙarin albashin yanki (locality pay): ƙarin albashi da ya danganta da yankin da aikin yake.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USAJOBS: Hanyoyin ɗaukar aiki
- USAJOBS: Buɗe ga jama'a
- OPM: General Schedule
Gwada yanzu: A takarda, ku jera kowace hanyar ɗaukar aiki da za ta iya dacewa da ku da dalilin haka (misali: "Buɗe ga jama'a: ni ɗan ƙasar Amurka ne" ko "Tsoffin sojoji: na yi aikin soja a Army"). Sannan ku buɗe usajobs.gov/hiringpath ku karanta shafin kowace hanya da ke cikin jerinku.
Yanzu za ku iya ambaci hanyoyin ɗaukar aikin da za su iya dacewa da ku, da duba ko aikin gwamnatin tarayya yana buɗe gare ku kafin ku ɓata lokaci a kansa.

check.q: Wata sanarwa ta ce "This job is open to: Federal employees - competitive service" (ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya kaɗai). Ba ku taɓa aiki a gwamnati ba. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku nema duk da haka da takardar bayanin aiki mai ƙarfi
Ku kira hukumar ku nemi a yi muku sassauci
Ku bar shi ku nemi aikin da ke buɗe ga jama'a
Ku nema da matsayin wani abokinku a gwamnati
check.why: Idan babu hanyar da aka jera da ta dace da ku, ba za a duba takardunku ba, don haka ya fi kyau ku yi amfani da lokacinku kan aikin da ke buɗe gare ku.

check.q: Wace hanyar ɗaukar aiki ce ta 'yan ƙasar Amurka da 'yan asalinta gaba ɗaya?
options: Special authorities (iko na musamman)
Senior executives (manyan shugabanni)
Federal employees (ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya)
Open to the public (buɗe ga jama'a)
check.why: "Open to the public" ita ce hanyar 'yan ƙasar Amurka da 'yan asalinta gaba ɗaya.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Buɗe asusun USAJOBS da bincike cikin hikima
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Buɗe asusu a USAJOBS da ajiye binciken aiki da aka tace.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da waya ko kwamfutar ɗakin karatu, za ku iya buɗe asusu (profile) a USAJOBS da ajiye binciken aiki da aka tace da wuri, matakin albashi da hanyar ɗaukar aiki, ta amfani da shafin hukuma na usajobs.gov kaɗai, ba tare da biyan kowa ba.
Ku je usajobs.gov ku zaɓi buɗe asusu (profile). USAJOBS tana amfani da Login.gov, hidimar shiga asusu ta gwamnati, don haka za ku buɗe asusun Login.gov da imel ɗinku, kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi da mataki na biyu na shiga (kamar code da ake turo wayarku). Ku rubuta adireshin da kanku; kada ku bi hanyoyin haɗi (links) a cikin saƙonnin tes ko talla.
A asusunku za ku saka bayanan tuntuɓarku kuma ku amsa tambayoyi game da kanku, kamar ko ku tsohon soja ne ko ma'aikacin gwamnatin tarayya a yanzu. Waɗannan amsoshi suna taimaka wa USAJOBS ta nuna muku hanyoyin ɗaukar aikin da suka dace da ku. Asusun kuma shi ne wurin da ake ajiye takardun bayanin aikinku da sauran takardu.
Don bincike, ku rubuta kalmar aiki ko ƙwarewa (misali "maintenance" (gyare-gyare), "customer service" (hidimar abokan ciniki) ko "medical support" (taimakon likitanci)) da birni ko jiha. Sannan ku yi amfani da matatun bincike (filters): wuri, matakin albashi, hanyar ɗaukar aiki, jadawalin aiki (cikakken lokaci ko rabin lokaci), da aiki daga nesa ko daga gida idan kuna so. Idan sakamakon ya yi daidai, ku ajiye binciken don USAJOBS ta riƙa aiko muku da sababbin ayyuka ta imel.
Amfani da USAJOBS kyauta ne. Babu ofishin gwamnati na gaske da ke cajin ku kuɗi don buɗe asusu, bincike ko neman aiki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta usajobs.gov a burauzar intanet da kanku.
- Ku buɗe asusu ku shiga ta Login.gov.
- Ku cika asusunku, har da tambayoyi game da matsayin tsohon soja da aikin gwamnatin tarayya.
- Ku yi bincike da kalmar aiki da wuri.
- Ku ƙara matatu: matakin albashi, hanyar ɗaukar aiki, jadawali.
- Ku ajiye binciken ku kunna sanarwa ta imel.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Asusu (profile): shafin asusunku a USAJOBS, inda ake ajiye bayananku, takardun bayanin aiki da sauran takardu.
- Login.gov: hidimar shiga asusu ta gwamnatin Amurka, da ake amfani da ita don shiga USAJOBS da sauran shafukan gwamnati.
- Matatar bincike (filter): saiti da ke rage sakamakon bincike, kamar wuri ko matakin albashi.
- Binciken da aka ajiye (saved search): binciken da USAJOBS ke tunawa kuma take amfani da shi don aiko muku da sababbin ayyuka masu dacewa ta imel.
- Telework: aiki daga gida a wani lokaci ko koyaushe.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USAJOBS
- Login.gov
- FTC: Zambar aiki
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe (ko ku shiga) asusunku na USAJOBS. Ku yi bincike ɗaya don irin aikin da za ku iya yi a yankinku, ku ƙara aƙalla matatu biyu, ku ajiye shi. Ku rubuta ayyuka nawa suka fito da sunayen uku daga cikinsu.
Yanzu za ku iya buɗe asusun USAJOBS lafiya da ajiye binciken da ke aiko muku da ayyukan da suka dace da ku.

check.q: Wani tes ya ce: "Ku nemi ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya a nan, kuɗin buɗewa $25" tare da hanyar haɗi. Mene ne gaskiya?
options: Zamba ce: amfani da USAJOBS kyauta ne
Ba laifi idan hanyar haɗin tana ƙarewa da .com
Ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya suna buƙatar asusun da ake biya
Ku biya da katin kyauta (gift card) don ku tsira
check.why: Bincike da neman ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya kyauta ne koyaushe, don haka duk wanda ke cajin kuɗi ɗan damfara ne.

check.q: Kuna son USAJOBS ta sanar da ku sababbin ayyukan rumbun ajiyar kaya kusa da ku. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku sake bincike kowace awa
Ku ajiye binciken ku kunna sanarwa ta imel
Ku nemi aboki ya riƙa duba shafin
Ku buɗe sabon asusu kowane mako
check.why: Binciken da aka ajiye tare da sanarwa yana aiko muku da sababbin ayyukan da suka dace da matatunku ta imel.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Karanta sanarwar aikin gwamnatin tarayya
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Jera ayyukan da za a yi, cancanta, matakin albashi, ranar rufewa da takardun da ake buƙata daga sanarwa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku sanarwar aiki ta gaske, za ku iya jera ayyukan da za a yi, cancanta, matakin albashi, ranar rufewa da takardun da ake buƙata, a takardar taƙaitawa ta shafi ɗaya, ba tare da rashin ko ɗaya daga cikin biyar ɗin ba.
Sanarwar aikin gwamnatin tarayya tana da tsawo, amma duk suna bin tsari ɗaya. A sama: sunan aikin, hukumar, wurin aiki, albashi da matakin albashi (grade), ranar buɗewa da ranar rufewa, da su wane ne aikin ke buɗe gare su. Sannan akwai sassa kamar Duties (ayyukan da za a yi), Requirements (sharuɗɗan ɗaukar aiki da cancanta), How you will be evaluated (yadda za a tantance ku), Required documents (takardun da ake buƙata) da How to apply (yadda ake nema).
Mafi muhimmancin sashe shi ne Qualifications (cancanta). Ayyuka da yawa suna neman ƙwarewa ta musamman (specialized experience): ƙwarewa a irin aikin da ake yi a wannan matsayin, wanda sau da yawa ake bayyana shi da shekara ɗaya a matakin da ke ƙasa da wanda ake nema. Wasu ayyuka suna bar ku ku cancanta da karatu a maimakon haka, ko haɗin biyun. Dole takardar bayanin aikinku ta nuna wannan ƙwarewa a sarari, in ba haka ba ana iya cewa ba ku cancanta ba.
Sharuɗɗan ɗaukar aiki (conditions of employment) ƙa'idoji ne da dole ku cika kafin a ɗauke ku, misali zama ɗan ƙasar Amurka, cin binciken tarihi (background check) ko gwajin ƙwayoyi, ko samun lasisin tuƙi. Ku karanta su kafin ku nema.
Ku kula da ranar rufewa. Wasu sanarwar kuma suna rufewa da wuri idan sun karɓi wani adadin takardun neman aiki, don haka ku nema da zarar kun shirya.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku kwafi sunan aikin, hukumar, lambar sanarwa, matakin albashi da albashi.
- Ku kwafi ranar buɗewa da ranar rufewa.
- Ku karanta "This job is open to".
- Ku kwafi ƙwarewa ta musamman ko karatun da kuke buƙata.
- Ku jera manyan ayyukan da za a yi.
- Ku jera kowace takarda a Required documents.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Ƙwarewa ta musamman (specialized experience): ƙwarewa a irin aikin da matsayin ke buƙata, a matakin da sanarwa ke nema.
- Sharuɗɗan ɗaukar aiki (conditions of employment): ƙa'idojin da dole ku cika kafin a ɗauke ku, kamar zama ɗan ƙasa ko binciken tarihi.
- Ranar rufewa (closing date): rana ta ƙarshe da za ku iya nema. Wasu ayyuka suna rufewa da wuri.
- Lambar sanarwa (announcement number): lambar da ke gane sanarwar aiki ɗaya; ku yi amfani da ita don bin diddigin neman aikinku.
- Takardun da ake buƙata (required documents): takardun da sanarwa ta ce dole ku ɗora (upload), kamar takardar bayanin aiki, sakamakon karatu (transcripts) ko DD-214.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USAJOBS
- OPM: Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi game da ɗaukar aikin gwamnatin tarayya
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaɓi sanarwa ɗaya ta gaske daga binciken da kuka ajiye wadda ke buɗe gare ku. A takarda ɗaya ku yi taƙaitaccen bayanin sanarwar: sunan aiki, hukuma, lambar sanarwa, matakin albashi da albashi, ranar rufewa, su wane ne aikin ke buɗe gare su, ƙwarewa ta musamman da kalmominku, manyan ayyuka uku, da kowace takardar da ake buƙata.
Yanzu za ku iya karanta sanarwar aikin gwamnatin tarayya da fitar da abin da kuke buƙata a shafi ɗaya.

check.q: Wane sashe ne ke faɗa muku ƙwarewar da dole takardar bayanin aikinku ta nuna?
options: How to apply (yadda ake nema)
Required documents (takardun da ake buƙata)
Next steps (matakai na gaba)
Qualifications (cancanta: ƙwarewa ta musamman)
check.why: Qualifications tana bayyana ƙwarewa ta musamman ko karatun da kuke buƙata don ku cancanta.

check.q: Wata sanarwa tana rufewa ranar Juma'a amma ta ce tana iya rufewa da wuri. Yaushe za ku nema?
options: Da zarar takardunku sun shirya
Ranar Juma'a da tsakar dare
Mako mai zuwa
Sai bayan hukumar ta kira ku
check.why: Ayyukan da ke iya rufewa da wuri suna iya daina karɓar takardu kafin ranar rufewa, don haka ku nema idan kun shirya.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Neman aiki da bin diddigi

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Rubuta takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya da ta dace da aikin
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta ayyuka a takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya da ke nuna ƙwarewa ta musamman da sanarwa ke nema.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku ƙwarewa ta musamman da sanarwa ke nema, za ku iya rubuta ayyuka a takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya, da ranaku, awanni a mako, ayyuka da sakamako da suka dace da sanarwar, ta amfani da muhimman kalmomin sanarwar da bayanai na gaskiya kaɗai.
Takardar bayanin aiki (resume) ta gwamnatin tarayya tana buƙatar ƙarin bayani fiye da yawancin na kamfanoni masu zaman kansu. Ga kowane aiki, ku saka sunan aikin, mai ɗaukar aikin, ranar farawa da ranar ƙarewa (wata da shekara) da awannin da kuka yi aiki a mako. Hukumomi suna amfani da ranaku da awanni don ƙidaya ƙwarewarku, don haka aikin da ba shi da su ana iya ƙin ƙidaya shi.
Ƙarƙashin kowane aiki, ku rubuta ayyukanku da sakamakonku da kalmomin sanarwar kanta. Idan sanarwa tana neman ƙwarewa a "maintaining inventory records" (riƙe bayanan kayayyaki), kuma kun yi haka, ku rubuta waɗannan kalmomi ku ƙara bayani: abin da kuka yi, yawansa, sau nawa, da abin da ya inganta. Misali: "Na riƙe bayanan kayayyaki 1,200 da na'urar duba lambar kaya ta hannu; na rage kuskuren ƙidaya da rabi cikin wata shida."
Ku ƙidaya duk ƙwarewa ta gaske: ayyukan albashi, aikin rabin lokaci, aikin soja, aikin sa-kai da ayyukan da kuka yi lokacin da kuke gidan yari, kamar aikin kicin, gyare-gyare ko aikin magatakarda. Ku faɗi gaskiya; kada ku taɓa da'awar ƙwarewar da ba ku da ita.
Ku karanta sanarwar da USAJOBS Help Center (cibiyar taimako ta USAJOBS) don kowace iyakar shafuka ko ƙa'idojin tsari, domin suna canjawa. Kuna iya gina takardar bayanin aiki a USAJOBS ko ku ɗora taku. Idan kuna amfani da kayan AI don taimako da kalmomi, ku bar lambobin sirri a waje, kuma ku duba cewa kowane layi gaskiya ne.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku kwafi jimlar ƙwarewa ta musamman daga takardar taƙaitawarku.
- Ku zaɓi ayyukan da kuka yi irin wannan aiki a cikinsu.
- Ga kowane aiki, ku rubuta sunan aiki, mai ɗaukar aiki, watan da shekarar farawa da ƙarewa, da awanni a mako.
- Ku rubuta layuka 3 zuwa 5 na ayyuka da sakamako ta amfani da muhimman kalmomin sanarwar.
- Ku ƙara lamba a aƙalla layi ɗaya: nawa, yawan nawa ko sau nawa.
- Ku duba sanarwar don iyakar shafuka, ku karanta duka da babbar murya don gaskiya da rubutu daidai.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya (federal resume): takardar bayanin aiki don aikin gwamnati, mai ranaku, awanni a mako da cikakken bayanin ayyuka ga kowane aiki.
- Muhimman kalmomi (key words): kalmomi masu muhimmanci daga sanarwar da ya kamata takardar bayanin aikinku ta maimaita inda suke gaskiya.
- Sakamako: abin da ya inganta saboda aikinku, mafi kyau da lamba.
- Awanni a mako: awanni nawa kuka yi aiki a mako a wani aiki; hukumomi suna amfani da su don ƙidaya ƙwarewarku.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USAJOBS
- OPM FedsHireVets
Gwada yanzu: Ta amfani da taƙaitaccen bayanin sanarwarku, ku rubuta ayyuka biyu na takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya a takarda ko a wata takarda ta kwamfuta. Kowanne yana buƙatar sunan aiki, mai ɗaukar aiki, ranaku da wata da shekara, awanni a mako, da layuka 3 zuwa 5 na ayyuka da sakamako da ke amfani da muhimman kalmomin sanarwar. Ku ja layi ƙarƙashin kowace muhimmiyar kalmar da kuka yi amfani da ita.
Yanzu za ku iya rubuta ayyuka a takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya da ranaku, awanni da ƙwarewar da ta dace, waɗanda hukuma ke buƙata don ƙidaya aikinku.

check.q: Wane bayanin aiki ne ya shirya don takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya?
options: "Ma'aikacin rumbun kaya, na yi abubuwa da yawa"
"Mataimaki a rumbun kaya, ABC Supply, 03/2022 zuwa 08/2024, awanni 40 a mako; na riƙe bayanan kayayyaki 1,200"
"Na yi aiki a rumbun kaya na ɗan lokaci"
"Mai ƙwazo, mai aiki tare da wasu"
check.why: Yana da sunan aiki, mai ɗaukar aiki, ranaku da wata da shekara, awanni a mako da aiki mai lamba.

check.q: Sanarwa tana neman ƙwarewa a "operating a forklift" (tuƙa forklift, motar ɗaga kaya). Kun tuƙa forklift lokacin da kuke gidan yari. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku bar shi domin ba ya ƙidayuwa
Ku ce kun tuƙa forklift a wani kamfani da ba ku taɓa aiki a ciki ba
Ku rubuta "aikin ƙarfi" kawai
Ku jera shi da gaskiya tare da ranaku, awanni da abin da kuka yi
check.why: Ƙwarewar aiki ta gaske tana ƙidayuwa, har da aikin da aka yi a gidan yari, idan an jera ta da gaskiya tare da bayanai.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Tambayoyin tantancewa da takardunku
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Amsa tambayoyin tantancewa da gaskiya da tara kowace takardar da sanarwa ke buƙata.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Kafin ku aika neman aiki, za ku iya amsa tambayoyin tantancewa da gaskiya da tara dukkan takardun da sanarwar ke buƙata, ta yadda takardar bayanin aikinku ke tabbatar da kowace babbar amsa, kuma babu takardar da ake buƙata da ta ɓace.
Sanarwa da yawa suna da tambayoyin tantancewa ta intanet (questionnaire). Kuna auna ƙwarewarku da kanku a kan ayyukan wannan matsayi, misali daga "I have no experience" (ba ni da ƙwarewa) har zuwa "I am an expert or have trained others" (ni ƙwararre ne ko na koyar da wasu). Amsoshinku suna taimakawa wajen yanke ko kun cancanta da matsayinku a jerin masu nema.
Ku amsa da gaskiya, kuma ku tabbata takardar bayanin aikinku tana tabbatar da kowace babbar amsa. Idan kun ce ku ƙwararru ne wajen tsara jadawali amma takardar bayanin aikinku ba ta taɓa ambaton tsara jadawali ba, mai dubawa yana iya rage makinku ko ya ce ba ku cancanta ba.
Sannan ku tara takardun da ke sashen Required documents. Waɗanda aka saba: takardar bayanin aikinku; sakamakon karatun jami'a (transcripts) idan kun cancanta ta karatu; ga tsoffin sojoji, DD-214 da ke nuna halin aikin soja, tare da SF-15 ko wasiƙar VA idan kuna neman fifikon maki 10; wasiƙar shaidar nakasa ta Schedule A idan kuna nema ta wannan hanya; da sabuwar takardar ma'aikata (SF-50) ga ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya na yanzu ko na da. Ku ɗora kwafi masu kyau da ake iya karantawa.
Wasu takardu suna tambaya game da tarihin laifi. Dokar tarayya gaba ɗaya tana iyakance lokacin da hukumomi za su iya tambaya kafin tayin aiki mai sharaɗi (conditional job offer), tare da keɓancewa ga wasu ayyuka kamar na jami'an tsaro. Idan aka tambaye ku, ku amsa da gaskiya: amsoshin ƙarya za su iya sa ku rasa aikin daga baya. Ku duba sanarwar da OPM don ƙa'idojin yanzu, kuma ku tambayi shirin taimakon masu dawowa gida ko na taimakon shari'a kyauta (legal aid) idan kuna da tambayoyi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta kowace tambayar tantancewa a hankali.
- Ku zaɓi amsar da ke gaskiya game da ku.
- Ga kowace babbar amsa, ku nemo layin takardar bayanin aiki da ke tabbatar da ita; ku ƙara ɗaya idan ƙwarewar gaskiya ce amma ba ta ciki.
- Ku jera kowace takardar da ake buƙata daga takardar taƙaitawarku.
- Ku rubuta inda za ku samo kowace (misali: DD-214 daga bayananku ko National Archives (taskar ƙasa), transcripts daga makarantarku).
- Ku ɗora kwafi masu kyau ku duba cewa kowanne yana buɗewa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tambayoyin tantancewa (questionnaire): tambayoyi ta intanet inda kuke auna ƙwarewarku da kanku a kan ayyukan matsayin.
- DD-214: takardar da ke nuna ranakun aikin soja na tsohon soja da halin aikinsa.
- SF-15: fom da ake amfani da shi don neman fifikon tsoffin sojoji na maki 10.
- Fifikon tsoffin sojoji (veterans' preference): ƙarin kulawa a ɗaukar aikin gwamnatin tarayya ga tsoffin sojojin da suka cancanta.
- SF-50: fom na ma'aikatan gwamnatin tarayya da ke nuna aikin ma'aikaci, matakin albashi da matsayinsa.
- Tayin aiki mai sharaɗi (conditional job offer): tayin aiki da ya dogara da cin binciken ƙarshe, kamar binciken tarihi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- USAJOBS: Hanyar ɗaukar aiki ta tsoffin sojoji (DD-214, SF-15, wasiƙar VA)
- OPM FedsHireVets: Fifikon tsoffin sojoji
- USAJOBS: Hanyoyin ɗaukar aiki (masu nakasa)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi jerin takardu don sanarwarku mai rukunai uku: takarda, inda zan samo ta, an gama. Sannan ku rubuta ayyuka uku irin na tambayoyin tantancewa daga ayyukan matsayin, ku auna kanku da gaskiya a kan kowanne, kuma kusa da kowace babbar amsa ku rubuta layin takardar bayanin aiki da ke tabbatar da ita.
Yanzu za ku iya amsa tambayoyin tantancewa na gwamnatin tarayya da gaskiya, tare da takardar bayanin aikinku a bayan kowace amsa, da tara dukkan takardun da aikin ke nema.

check.q: Kun auna kanku "ƙwararre" wajen tsara jadawali, amma takardar bayanin aikinku ba ta taɓa ambaton tsara jadawali ba. Me zai iya faruwa?
options: Mai dubawa yana iya rage makinku ko ya ce ba ku cancanta ba
Babu komai; tambayoyin tantancewa kaɗai ke ƙidayuwa
Za a ɗauke ku aiki da sauri
Hukumar za ta ƙara shi a takardar bayanin aikinku a madadinku
check.why: Masu dubawa suna duba cewa takardar bayanin aikinku tana tabbatar da amsoshin tambayoyin tantancewarku.

check.q: Wani tsohon soja yana neman fifikon maki 10. Me ya kamata ya ɗora, bisa ga USAJOBS?
options: Takardar bayanin aiki kaɗai
Wasiƙa daga aboki
DD-214 tare da SF-15 ko wasiƙar VA da aka yarda da ita
Hoton kayan sojansa
check.why: USAJOBS tana neman DD-214, da SF-15 ko wata shaida da aka yarda da ita kamar wasiƙar VA don fifikon maki 10.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Aikawa, bin diddigi da kiyaye kanku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Bin diddigin matsayin neman aikinku a USAJOBS da gane tayin aikin gwamnati na bogi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Bayan kun nemi aiki, za ku iya bin diddigin matsayin neman aikinku da gane tayin aikin gwamnati na bogi, kuna ajiye rajista mai ranaku, kuma ba ku taɓa biyan kuɗi ko bayar da lambobin sirri a wajen USAJOBS ba. Idan aka ba ku ƙwarewa ta musamman da sanarwa ke nema, za ku iya rubuta ayyuka a takardar bayanin aiki ta gwamnatin tarayya, da ranaku, awanni a mako, ayyuka da sakamako da suka dace da sanarwar, ta amfani da muhimman kalmomin sanarwar da bayanai na gaskiya kaɗai.
Idan kun nema, USAJOBS tana tura ku zuwa tsarin neman aiki na hukumar don ku kammala. Ku tabbata kun kammala kowane mataki kuma kun sami tabbaci (confirmation); barin shafin bayan tambayoyin tantancewa dalili ne da aka saba gani da ke sa takardun neman aiki ba su isa ba.
Ku bi diddigin kowane neman aiki a asusunku na USAJOBS. Matsayin yana canjawa yayin da hukumar ke aiki: misali received (an karɓa), being reviewed (ana dubawa), referred (an tura wa manajan ɗaukar aiki) ko not referred (ba a tura ba), daga baya kuma selected (an zaɓa) ko not selected (ba a zaɓa ba). Ɗaukar aikin gwamnatin tarayya yana iya ɗaukar makonni ko watanni, don haka ku ci gaba da neman wasu ayyuka yayin da kuke jira. Idan ba a tura ku ba, ku karanta sanarwar ku gyara wannan sashe (sau da yawa ƙwarewa, ranaku ko takardun da suka ɓace) a neman aiki na gaba.
Ku riƙe rajista mai sauƙi: sunan aiki, lambar sanarwa, hukuma, ranar da kuka nema, matsayi da ranar da za ku sake dubawa. Ku duba kusan sau ɗaya a mako.
Ku yi hankali da zamba. Neman ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya kyauta ne koyaushe. Ku yi hankali da duk wanda ya yi alƙawarin aikin gwamnati da kuɗi, ya nemi a biya shi ko katin kyauta, ya nemi lambar Social Security ko ta bankinku ta tes ko hira, ko ya yi muku hirar aiki ta tes kaɗai. Imel da shafukan gwamnatin tarayya na gaske suna ƙarewa da .gov ko .mil. Idan kuna shakka, ku rubuta usajobs.gov da kanku ku duba a can.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku kammala kowane mataki a tsarin hukumar ku ajiye tabbacin.
- Ku fara rajistar neman aikinku.
- Ku duba matsayin a USAJOBS kusan sau ɗaya a mako.
- Idan ba a tura ku ba, ku karanta dalilin ku gyara shi a gaba.
- Kada ku taɓa biyan kuɗi, kuma kada ku taɓa aika lambobin sirri ta tes ko hira.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Referred (an tura): an tura takardunku zuwa ga manajan ɗaukar aiki don ya duba su.
- Not referred (ba a tura ba): ba a tura takardunku gaba ba, sau da yawa saboda hukumar ta ga ba ku cancanta ba ko wasu masu nema sun fi ku maki.
- Rajistar neman aiki: jerinku na ayyukan da kuka nema, da ranaku da matsayi.
- .gov: ƙarshen adireshin shafin intanet da hukumomin gwamnatin Amurka kaɗai ke amfani da shi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FTC: Zambar aiki (neman ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya kyauta ne)
- USAJOBS
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku haɗa fakitin neman aikinku na atisaye don sanarwarku: taƙaitawa ta shafi ɗaya, aƙalla ayyuka biyu masu dacewa a takardar bayanin aiki, jerin takardu da rajistar neman aiki mai lambar aikin, ranar da za ku nema da ranar sake dubawa. Sannan ku karanta fakitin a kan ma'aunin rubric ku gyara wani sashe ɗaya mai rauni.
Yanzu za ku iya haɗa cikakken neman aikin gwamnatin tarayya, bin diddiginsa, da kiyaye kanku daga tayin aiki na bogi.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Aikin yana buɗe gare ku Aikin da aka zaɓa ba ya buɗe ga kowace hanyar ɗaukar aiki da ta dace da mai koyo. Aikin yana buɗe ga hanyar ɗaukar aiki da ta dace, kuma taƙaitawar ta ambace ta. Ya kuma jera wasu hanyoyin da mai koyo zai iya amfani da su da ƙarin aiki ɗaya da ke buɗe. Taƙaitaccen bayanin sanarwa Ɗaya ko fiye daga cikin ayyukan da za a yi, cancanta, matakin albashi, ranar rufewa ko takardun da ake buƙata ya ɓace. Duk biyar ɗin suna shafi ɗaya da kalmomin mai koyo. Ya kuma rubuta sharuɗɗan ɗaukar aiki da ko aikin yana iya rufewa da wuri. Ayyuka a takardar bayanin aiki Ayyukan ba su da ranaku na wata da shekara, awanni a mako ko ayyukan da suka dace da aikin. Ayyuka biyu ko fiye da sunan aiki, mai ɗaukar aiki, ranaku, awanni da ayyuka masu amfani da muhimman kalmomin sanarwar. Kowane aiki yana da aƙalla sakamako ɗaya mai lamba, kuma duk layukan gaskiya ne kuma a sarari. Takardu da tambayoyin tantancewa Wata takardar da ake buƙata ba ta cikin jerin, ko wata babbar amsa ba ta da layin takardar bayanin aiki a bayanta. An jera kowace takardar da ake buƙata da inda za a samo ta, kuma kowace babbar amsa tana da layin takardar bayanin aiki da ke tabbatar da ita. An riga an tara takardun kuma an duba cewa ana iya karanta su. Bin diddigi da tsaro Babu rajista, ko rajistar ko fakitin yana da lambobin sirri. Rajista mai lambar aiki, ranaku, matsayi da ranar sake dubawa; babu lambobin sirri. Mai koyo zai iya ambaton alamun gargaɗin zamba uku da yadda ake duba aiki a usajobs.gov. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake dubawa.

check.q: Wani a kafofin sada zumunta yana ba ku tabbacin aiki a wata hukumar gwamnatin tarayya idan kun biya kuɗin aiki $200. Mene ne wannan?
options: Mataki na yau da kullum na ɗaukar aikin gwamnatin tarayya
Hanyar tsallake layi bisa doka
Zamba ce: neman ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya kyauta ne
Kuɗin da USAJOBS ke cajin tsoffin sojoji
check.why: FTC ta ce neman ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya kyauta ne koyaushe, kuma duk wanda ke cajin kuɗi don su ɗan damfara ne.

check.q: Matsayinku a USAJOBS ya ce "Not referred" (ba a tura ba). Mene ne mataki mafi kyau na gaba?
options: Ku daina neman ayyukan gwamnatin tarayya
Ku karanta sanarwar ku gyara sashe mai rauni a neman aikinku na gaba
Ku biya wani ya canja matsayinku
Ku sake neman wannan aikin da aka rufe
check.why: Sanarwar sau da yawa tana nuna abin da ya ɓace, don ku gyara shi a gaba.
